operation: Single-token FP32 x complete IQ2_S GGUF tensor -> FP32 projection, with nonzero FP32 bias
scope: One resident projection only. This is not full-model generation tok/s. Packing is reported separately from repeated decode.

signedLookupPreparation.scope: One shared 128 KiB lookup allocation for all tensors; original 82-byte GGUF weights remain unchanged

layout: Exactly 82 bytes per original 256-value block in one allocation: all 64-byte ushort low-index/sign planes, all 16-byte pre-folded high-index/scale planes, then all 2-byte raw FP16 coefficients. No weight expansion or requantization.

timing.order: Round robin; reverse route order on alternate warmup/sample rounds
timing.decodeWall: Per-call batch average: dispatch iterations then synchronize once; input, encoded/packed weight, bias, output already resident
timing.decodeGpu: Not collected; use a separate --profile 1 run for kernel evidence
timing.excludedFromDecode: Compilation, initial allocation/upload, weight packing, CPU reference, poison/readback validation, model reads and hashing
timing.packing: First preparation includes allocation+pack+sync after kernel handles are created; repeated pack statistics use the existing output allocation. CPU pack is one allocation+conversion measurement.
timing.comparison: Only compare primary wall times from unprofiled runs; profile wall times are diagnostics.

validation.packedBytes: GPU packed bytes must equal independent CPU packing, and CPU unpacking must reproduce every original GGUF byte

memory.note: Both raw and packed weights stay resident for the comparison. Replacing raw storage saves that duplicate only if the model no longer needs raw weights for another route.
